expect.notes: As remesh_3d_db.json, with an empty 64bit.DAT in the run directory: the 3D .com wrappers (DEF_REM3_GUI 0x401240, DEF_AMG3_GUI, MESH3D_GUI) then run their 64-bit programs (DEF_REM_64.EXE ...), as in a GUI project directory. Object 1 assumed to be the workpiece (check the DB). Launch order: AMG_DXT3 > DEF_BRD.OUT; DEF_AMG3_GUI < DEF_MGN.ACT > DEF_MGN.OUT; MESH3D_GUI; BRKMSH > BRKMSH.MSG (or a 2nd DEF_AMG3_GUI if mesh.out missing); DEF_REM3_GUI < DEF_INT.ACT > DEF_INT.OUT (reads SCRATCH.KEY, DEF_REM3.INI; result NEWMESH.KEY). If AMG_DXT3 succeeded (DAT_1406e2d78 = 1) DEFAMG writes no NBCD.DAT and does not read NBCD.OUT.
